title: Payment Arrangement Credit Schedule — Missed-Installment Share on Reinstatement
content:
# Payment Arrangement Credit Schedule — Missed-Installment Share on Reinstatement

**Schedule.** When a defaulted Standard Deferred Payment Agreement or Extended Deferred Payment Agreement of the Payment Arrangement program is reinstated, the missed-installment share is:

| Missed-installment entries posted on the plan within the 6 months before the request | Missed-installment share |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 15% |
| Exactly two | 10% |
| Fewer than two | 0 |

The count reads the plan's own history: its missed-installment entries, each posted on the day after the cure period of the installment ended unpaid. A window of 6 months before the request covers entries posted after the same calendar day 6 months earlier, up to and including the request date. Missed-installment entries posted before that window have aged out of it and do not count, even though they remain on the plan.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical request dated July 10)

| Entry posted on | Inside the 6 months before the request |
|---|---|
| January 10 | No — the window covers entries posted after January 10 |
| January 11 | Yes |
| July 10 | Yes — the request date is included |

## Worked readings (hypothetical plans, request dated July 10)

| Missed entries on the plan | Of which posted after January 10 | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 3 | 15% |
| 4 | 2 | 10% |
| 2 | 1 | 0 |
| 3 | 0 | 0 |
